name: Mark of the Fey
body:
You have been marked by the fey, although such a blessing is not without its price.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, 1st-level druid

Benefit: You may add your Charisma bonus to all saving throws against spells or spell-like effects. However, you do not gain this bonus against fey opponents.

Special: This feat can only be chosen at 1st level.
